correctness.rationale: For arbitrary field, direct DVR-lattice normal form I=(x^{b+h},x^b(y+g))_A has length 2b+h; y-stability iff x^h divides x^{2d+1}-g². Odd valuation forces h<=2d+1, and the reduced solution space is the affine space with coefficients of g from ceil(h/2) through h-1. Modulo x contact is 1 for b=0,h>0 and 2 for b>0, yielding the exact rational identity. Summing z=1 recovers the known unrefined theorem. The arbitrary-germ fat-branch identity is credited to Cor 6.8. Independent direct finite-field congruence enumeration checked 48 cases; general proof does not rely on it. Reduced strata, not nonreduced Hilbert schemes, are claimed.

The theorem gives a closed two-variable all-colength result for the entire natural A_{2d} series d>=2 over every field, computes actual contact strata instead of only the known unrefined zeta, and feeds the established fat-branch modification identity for all u. No downstream theorem beyond this exact invariant is needed for its structural motivation.
